source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Network Address Translation (NAT)' (PDF 16): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: NAT ka matlab hai Network Address Translation. Yeh bohat se devices ko ek public IP address (Internet par nazar aane wala address) share karne deta hai. NAT router karta hai. Yeh private IP addresses (ghar ya office ke andar wale addresses) ko chhupata hai. Is se network ki security behtar hoti hai. NAT networks mein aam istemal hota hai.

blocks.alt: Teen computers jin ke private IP addresses 192.168.1.10, 192.168.1.11 aur 192.168.1.12 hain, aik router (NAT) se jure hain; router Internet se aik public IP 203.0.113.5 ke zariye jura hai.
blocks.caption: NAT: kai private addresses aik public IP address share karte hain (asal khaaka, kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: NAT kya karta hai, aur yeh security kaise barhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh private IP addresses wale bohat se devices ko ek public IP address share karne deta hai; router andar ke private addresses ko bahar se chhupaye rakhta hai, is liye security behtar hoti hai.

items: NAT: bohat se devices ek public IP share karte hain; router karta hai; private addresses chhup jate hain.
